note: P36.37 (SIG-UI-097, K0 §4.7) — the browser-shipped runtime dependency allow-list. Browser code on a public bundle may come only from a package named under `browser`; the vendored MapLibre ESM split is pinned by scripts/prepare-map-vendor.mjs. `react` is listed under `transitional` — it may still ship on /network/ and /search/ until their migration rows, but MUST NOT appear in the /map/ bundle after this row.

browser.preact: the only island runtime (K0 D-K0-2; UXK0-6 absorbed here for /map/)
browser.maplibre-gl: the T2 map renderer (self-hosted ESM split under /map/vendor/)

transitional.react: legacy island runtime — /network/ and /search/ only, until their own migration rows
